scope: Remove the added ARM instruction cost on RP2040 powers-of-two multiplication and dyadic-seed division without changing Cortex-M4 or full-significand profiles.

implementation.power_multiply: For a guarded normal product with one exact power-of-two operand, high_result = high_a + high_b - 0x3ff00000 modulo 2^32. The exponent range proves that the final magnitude does not spill into the sign. Modulo arithmetic XORs the signs and preserves the other operand fraction. Only the low result word is moved when the first operand is the power of two; no high-word swap or mantissa unpacking is needed.
implementation.power_divide: For a guarded normal quotient by a power of two, high_result = high_a - high_b + 0x3ff00000 modulo 2^32. The low dividend word is unchanged. No rounding is needed.
implementation.dyadic_seed: Move the seed helper before the division entry so a Thumb-1 conditional branch reaches it directly. The three-bit index already contains the entire divisor fraction; form its normal high word directly. Use ADR for the reciprocal table, avoiding the address-literal read. The reciprocal values and exact quotient/refinement/rounding core are unchanged.
implementation.sio: The nine-ALU-instruction SIO latency block is unchanged. Power/seed shortcuts do not access the divider; the existing dirty-divider preservation checks pass.
implementation.license: Existing BSD-3-Clause foundation and project changes; external Qfplib is never copied or linked into firmware.
